| `claude -n "my-feature-work"` |
| `--no-chrome` | Disable [Chrome browser integration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/chrome.md) for this session | `claude --no-chrome` |
| `--no-session-persistence` | Disable session persistence so sessions are not saved to disk and cannot be resumed. Print mode only. The [`CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY`](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) environment variable does the same in any mode | `claude -p --no-session-persistence "query"` |
| `--output-format` | Specify output format for print mode (options: `text`, `json`, `stream-json`) | `claude -p "query" --output-format json` |
| `--permission-mode` | Begin in a specified [permission mode](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes.md). Accepts `default`, `acceptEdits`, `plan`, `auto`, `dontAsk`, `bypassPermissions`, or `manual` as an alias for `default`. The `manual` alias selects the permission mode the UI labels Manual and requires Claude Code v2.1.200 or later; `claude --help` lists it in place of `default`, and both values work. Overrides `defaultMode` from settings files. Without this flag or `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, a new session starts in the permission mode described in [which permission mode a session starts in](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes.md#which-mode-a-session-starts-in), which also covers what a `-p` run starts in | `claude --permission-mode plan` |
